cohort: The study included 176 neonates diagnosed with nosocomial gastrointestinal infections and a control group of 675 neonates without such diagnoses, all from a NICU between 2020 and 2024.
finding: A Neural Network model effectively predicted neonatal gastrointestinal infections using nine significant risk factors, demonstrating robust performance and supporting early identification and timely interventions for at-risk neonates.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was identified as one of the nine significant feature variables contributing to the predictive model for neonatal gastrointestinal infections.
